turns.replyText:
Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Our two most popular lines are Jute and Ultra Durable.
Jute Braided Rugs offer natural texture and rich colors. Tightly braided from natural fibers, they are non-shedding, soft underfoot, and completely reversible.
Ultra Durable Braided Rugs are made from water-resistant polypropylene. Spills wipe right off, small sizes are machine washable, and larger sizes can be hosed off outdoors.
If you have pets, kids, or heavy messes, Ultra Durable is your best bet. If you prefer natural warmth and texture for standard everyday living spaces, Jute is the top choice.
